title: Do I Have Enough Fat for a BBL? The Skinny BBL Explained
meta_description: No source sets a minimum amount of fat for a BBL. What a skinny BBL is, how much fat a BBL usually moves, and what leaner patients can ask at an exam.
excerpt: No source we read sets a minimum amount of fat or a minimum BMI for a BBL, so an exam decides. Here is how much fat a BBL usually moves, what a skinny BBL is, and what leaner patients can ask, including when implants may suit them better.
quick_answer:
Do I have enough fat for a BBL?

Only an exam can tell you. No source we read sets a minimum amount of fat or a minimum BMI. Cleveland Clinic says a BBL usually moves 300 ccs to 500 ccs on each side, while ASPS's article on the skinny BBL says it focuses on shape over volume. Very slender patients may be recommended implants.

Do I have enough fat for a BBL?
Minimum fat or BMI | No source we read sets one
A usual BBL | 300 ccs to 500 ccs on each side (Cleveland Clinic)
A skinny BBL | A smaller volume, with no published figure
Fat retained | 60% to 80% on average (ASPS)
Very slender, little excess fat | Your surgeon may recommend butt implants (The Aesthetic Society)
